summary: Templates support standard Backstage types (string, number, integer, boolean, array) and widgets (textarea, select, checkboxes, hidden), plus AAP-specific fields: AAPTokenField (hidden OAuth2 token, always in auto-generated templates), AAPResourcePicker single-select (inventory, organization) and multi-select with type: array (credentials).
